title: full-resolution preview quality (GPU only)
description:
Owner request 2026-11-23: now that the GPU preview works, add a full
resolution preview. Preview quality gains a fourth level, FULL:
playback at the recorded resolution (SOURCE_MAX_DIM, no cap) and scrub
at the 1280 settle tier. It is GPU-only: PreviewQuality.effectiveFor
resolves FULL to HIGH whenever the GPU preview is not the renderer
(CPU/AUTO backend, GPU session not up yet, zebra on — zebra forces the
CPU path), so a CPU develop is never asked to play 4K. The stored
choice stays FULL across those fallbacks. Settings shows a fourth
segment with a "recorded resolution, GPU only" hint (EN/TR).

Device verification pending (playback fps at 4K on the GPU path).
